add.k: A jailed Albanian boss holding court at Rikers
st: Jailed at Rikers, Vic owns up to the convoy ambush, names Jasper Evans as Fisk's paid stabber, and helps Matt escape the riot.

files.notes: Named in dialogue ('an introduction to Vic Jusufi'). The group is said on screen as the Albanian Syndicate (S3E2, S3E5). Raft file: a crime boss whose men killed federal agents, who only briefly deals with Matt; still in custody at the end.

k: An FBI agent on Fisk's protective detail
An FBI agent secretly working for Fisk
st: Wellers guards Fisk, drags Karen out of his suite, takes Fisk's orders with the other bought agents, and is beaten to death by him.

files.notes: First named in S3E7 ('Wellers, we have a situation'); on screen unnamed from S3E2. Joins Fisk's Empire from S3E9, when he is among the agents coerced into serving Fisk (as the app files Tammy Hattley); unlike Nadeem he never turns on Fisk. Killed by Fisk in S3E11 after reporting that Nadeem let the NYPD take Karen.

st: Winn questions Fisk about the convoy shootout, suspends Poindexter, and records Nadeem's confession before Hattley shoots him dead.

files.notes: Introduced by name in S3E4 ('Supervisory Special Agent Winn with OPR'). OPR is part of the FBI, so the group is FBI.

add.k: Captain of the Northern Star, running Fisk's guns
st: Achilleo scuttles the Northern Star with Daredevil aboard, hides with Ariana, and is caught, beaten by Powell and shot dead by Buck.

files.notes: Named by Matt and Cherry in S2E1 ('Achilleo Kyriaco and Christofi Savva'). The ship's crew is never named as a group and the app files his first mate Christofi Savva as Independent, so Independent. He is a hired captain for Fisk's shipment, not shown as part of Fisk's organization.

st: Steverud demands oversight of Fisk until a call from de Fontaine makes him fold, then later files charges and offers Fisk exile.

files.notes: Answers his phone 'Steverud' in S2E1; his office answers 'Alan Steverud's office' in S2E7. On screen in S2E1, voice only in S2E7; his charges and resignation offer reach Fisk through others in S2E8. Group uses the app's 'New York State', as for Governor McCaffrey.

add.k: The surgeon operating on Vanessa Fisk
st: Dr. Merati operates on Vanessa and stays hopeful, then consoles Fisk after her death and is crushed to death in his embrace.

files.notes: Introduces himself as 'Arash Merati' in S2E5. The hospital is named on screen by a reporter as Metro General Hospital.

add.k: An Astoria restaurant owner smuggling people out
st: Ariana hides Achilleo until Powell strikes her, is jailed by the Task Force, then is freed by Daredevil and testifies against Fisk.

files.notes: Unnamed in S2E1, called Ariana in S2E2, gives her full name in her recorded testimony in S2E6. Her restaurant's name is not said in the dialogue, and helping Matt's side is ally work, so Independent.

st: Artemis calls Fisk's port project a self-serving con to his face, then turns up uneasy at his ball, unsure where her husband is.

files.notes: Only 'Artemis' is said (Jack Duquesne, S1E8); the surname Sledge is credits only, so the file uses Artemis. Unnamed at the S1E6 fundraiser.

k: The District Attorney prosecuting Hector Ayala
The District Attorney trying vigilantes for Fisk
st: Hochberg prosecutes Hector Ayala, warns Matt that his 500 ADAs will hound him after the White Tiger reveal, and loses the verdict.
Hochberg wins Duquesne's conviction with Heather's report, then prosecutes Karen Page until the court dismisses the case.

files.notes: Introduces himself as 'Benjamin Hochberg' in S1E2. A prosecutor in S1, he runs Fisk's rigged vigilante trials in S2 and takes Fisk's orders on Karen's charges, so a Raft file. Group uses the app's 'Manhattan DA's Office' (the DA's office is named on screen).

add.k: Foggy's thief client, hiding in his apartment
st: Hiding in Foggy's apartment, Benny phones him in a panic, then apologizes that the intruder wanted to know where Foggy was.

files.notes: Heard only over the phone (voice) in S1E1, where Foggy calls him Benny; Vanessa names him 'Benjamin Cafaro' in S1E9. His fate after the intruder's attack is never shown, so Missing.

add.k: A bodega owner in Angela's neighborhood
st: Berto pulls a shotgun on Javi before the Task Force drags him off, then is freed by Daredevil and testifies against Fisk.

files.notes: Named by Soledad ('Hola, Berto') in S2E2. His bodega has no name said on screen; recording testimony is ally work, so Independent.

st: Javi clashes with Berto in his bodega, passes Angela's SD card to BB, and is knocked down when the Task Force charges a protest.

files.notes: Only 'Javi' is said (first in S2E4); Espinosa is credits only. He works the counter at Arriba Arepas, named on screen in S2E4 ('welcome to Arriba Arepas').

add.k: Matt and Foggy's boss at Landman and Zack
st: Years earlier, Levine wants Matt and Foggy to make Lionel McCoy plead out, then berates them and sticks them with the case files.

files.notes: Foggy calls him 'Jeff' and is corrected to 'Mr. Levine' (S2E5). The firm is not named in this scene; it is the same firm as Matt and Foggy's earlier job, so the app's 'Landman and Zack'.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Matt, inside Rikers on Foggy's ID, wants an introduction to Vic, who has his men pull Matt out of the riot. Vic tells him Fisk paid Jasper Evans to stab him and helps Matt escape to find Evans, warning him to keep his word.
stages.whoA: The lawyer he sends after Fisk
stages.whoB: The jailed Albanian boss who helps him escape

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Wellers guards Fisk at the hotel and, like the other bought agents, comes to take his orders. When Wellers reports that Nadeem let the NYPD take Karen, Fisk beats him to death in the car.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he guards, then serves
stages.whoB: An agent on his detail he kills

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Wellers cheers Nadeem's raid on the Albanians and tips him off about the fight over Fisk's detail. Later he tells Fisk it was Nadeem's call to let the NYPD take Karen.
stages.whoA: A fellow agent on Fisk's detail
stages.whoB: A fellow agent on Fisk's detail

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Wellers stops Karen outside Fisk's suite, then lets her in to talk to him. When Foggy warns that she means to kill Fisk, Wellers cuffs her and drags her out.
stages.whoA: The reporter he drags from Fisk's suite

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Hattley gathers the agents who now work for Fisk, Wellers among them. She sends him back to the hotel to keep up appearances while Fisk meets the crime bosses.
stages.whoA: His boss, giving Fisk's orders

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Nadeem calls Winn to Hattley's house and, on the record, says Fisk has corrupted Poindexter and the bureau. Hattley places Nadeem on leave, and Winn moves to call him an ambulance before Hattley kills Winn with Nadeem's gun.
stages.whoA: The agent whose confession he records
stages.whoB: The OPR investigator he confides in

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Winn and Hattley interview Fisk about the convoy and put Poindexter on leave together. At her house, as Nadeem confesses, Hattley shoots Winn dead with Nadeem's gun.
stages.whoA: The SAC who works with him, then kills him

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Winn sends Poindexter out for coffee so he can question Fisk alone about the shooting. After the story leaks, Winn suspends him and takes his badge and gun.
stages.whoA: The agent he investigates and suspends
stages.whoB: The OPR investigator who suspends him

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Winn interviews Fisk about the Albanians Poindexter shot, and Fisk backs Poindexter's story. Fisk's hold over the bureau later costs Winn his life.
stages.whoA: The witness he questions

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Achilleo captains the Northern Star with Christofi as first mate and overrules his protest about the crew. The two scuttle the ship and split up to hide.
stages.whoA: His first mate

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Powell spots Achilleo hiding at Ariana's restaurant and beats him down in the alley. In a cell he tortures Achilleo for Christofi's whereabouts.
stages.whoA: The Task Force officer who tortures him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Buck sends Powell out and talks gently to Achilleo, who begs to go home. Buck agrees none of it is his fault and shoots him in the head.
stages.whoA: His killer

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Achilleo watches Daredevil fight through his crew on the ship's cameras and sinks the Northern Star with him aboard. Matt then hunts for him to protect him, too late.
stages.whoA: The masked man who boards his ship
stages.whoB: The captain who sinks the ship on him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Achilleo comes to Ariana for help, and she hides him and plans to get him to Toronto and on to Cyprus. The Task Force finds him at her restaurant and takes him.
stages.whoA: The captain she tries to smuggle out

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Matt finds Ariana after the raid and they agree to try to help Christofi. Later Daredevil frees her from the Task Force cells and works out of her hideout.
stages.whoA: The lawyer, and Daredevil, who frees her

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Powell raids Ariana's restaurant, strikes her when she calls the Task Force fascists, and seizes Achilleo. During the breakout, his officers open fire on her and the other prisoners.
stages.whoA: The Task Force officer who beats her

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Christofi was hidden thanks to Ariana, and he says she was captured for helping him. He comes to her hideout to tell the resistance about the Northern Star.
stages.whoA: The first mate she shelters
stages.whoB: The woman who was jailed for helping him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Karen and Angela pull Ariana and the other escaped prisoners into an armored truck under fire. Ariana tells them she knows a place to hide.
stages.whoA: One of her rescuers
stages.whoB: An escaped prisoner with a hideout

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Both are freed from the Task Force cells and hide together. They record testimony about being caged for weeks, played to protesters against Fisk.
stages.whoA: A fellow freed prisoner

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Ariana and Berto escape the Task Force cells together and hide at her safe place. Both record testimony about their arrests under Fisk.
stages.whoA: A fellow freed prisoner
stages.whoB: The woman who hides the escapees

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Steverud tells Fisk his Safer Streets moves need oversight, then folds after a call from de Fontaine. Later he files charges against Fisk and offers him exile in place of prosecution.
stages.whoA: The mayor he first backs, then charges

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles barges into Steverud's meeting with Fisk and mocks him. Steverud insists he won't be intimidated, then takes the call Charles tells him to take and backs down.
stages.whoA: The CIA man who makes him back down

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: The Governor calls Steverud and tells him to move on the paperwork to suspend Fisk. She warns him that their window is now.
stages.whoA: The Governor

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Dr. Merati promises Fisk he will do all he can for Vanessa and reports a hopeful surgery. After she dies he consoles Fisk, who crushes him to death.
stages.whoA: The mayor whose wife he treats

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Dr. Merati takes on Vanessa's case after she is wounded and operates on her. He tells Fisk the long surgery went well.
stages.whoA: His critical patient

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: At his fundraiser, Artemis tells Fisk his port project is a self-serving con and that her circle still decides who gets to eat. Later she comes to his ball afraid to offend him.
stages.whoA: The mayor she scorns, then fears
stages.whoB: A socialite who mocks his plans

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Jack greets Artemis warmly at Fisk's ball and is surprised she came. When he asks after her husband Arthur, she rushes away.
stages.whoA: A fellow socialite

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hochberg prosecutes Hector Ayala with Matt for the defense, and Matt's White Tiger reveal infuriates him. Hochberg vows his ADAs will hound Matt, then loses the verdict.
stages.whoA: The defense lawyer who beats him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Matt walks into Karen's trial and objects to Hochberg's case. Over Hochberg's objections Matt questions Fisk, and the court dismisses the charges.
stages.whoA: Karen's lawyer, who wrecks his case

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Hochberg, her old boss, urges Kirsten to plead out Duquesne and come back to the DA's office, and she tells him off. He then beats her in Duquesne's rigged trial and faces her again at Karen's.
stages.whoA: His former protege, now opposing counsel
stages.whoB: Her old boss at the DA's office

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hochberg has Hector remanded and argues he killed Officer Shanahan. After the White Tiger reveal he tells the jury a masked man can't be trusted, but Hector is acquitted.
stages.whoA: The defendant he prosecutes

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Hochberg calls Powell as his witness and walks him through Shanahan's death. Powell claims Hector attacked them unprovoked.
stages.whoA: His star witness

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Powell takes the stand for Hochberg at Karen's trial. Both stand on Fisk's side of the vigilante trials.
stages.whoA: A witness for the prosecution

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Hochberg calls Heather about her report on Duquesne and nudges her to make him look like a sociopath. At Karen's trial he has her read from her book on masked men.
stages.whoA: The psychiatrist whose report he uses

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Fisk orders Hochberg to charge Karen with everything and convict her on all of it. When Fisk takes the stand, Hochberg advises him not to answer, and Fisk waves him off.
stages.whoA: The mayor who gives him orders
stages.whoB: The District Attorney doing his bidding

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Hochberg charges Karen with aiding Daredevil and inciting a riot and paints her as a sociopath in court. The judges dismiss the case with prejudice.
stages.whoA: The defendant he prosecutes

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Hochberg prosecutes Jack at the first vigilante trial, reading Heather's report to cast him as a killer. The judges find Jack guilty.
stages.whoA: The defendant he convicts

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Foggy defends Benny for stealing wine from a Red Hook warehouse and hides him in his apartment after threats. Benny calls him in a panic as an intruder breaks in.
stages.whoA: His lawyer

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Javi tries to swipe a drink from Berto's bodega, and Berto pulls a shotgun on him. The Task Force storms in and drags Berto away.
stages.whoA: The bodega owner who pulls a gun on him
stages.whoB: The kid stealing from his store

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Soledad greets Berto at his bodega and begs him not to shoot Javi. Both are freed from the Task Force cells and record testimony against Fisk.
stages.whoA: A regular, and a fellow prisoner

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Daredevil breaks Berto out of the Task Force cells with the other prisoners. Berto then hides with Daredevil's allies and records his story.
stages.whoA: Daredevil, who frees him

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Javi teases Angela in the bodega before the raid, and later she trusts him to deliver an SD card. When he is knocked down at the protest, she screams for him.
stages.whoA: His friend from the neighborhood

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Posing as a fan asking for a photo, Javi slips BB the SD card Angela gave him.
stages.whoA: The reporter he passes the SD card to
stages.whoB: The fan who passes her an SD card

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Levine wants young Matt and Foggy to get Lionel McCoy to plead out. When McCoy goes to a public defender, Levine berates them and has them collate the files all weekend.
stages.whoA: A young associate under him
stages.whoB: His boss at Landman and Zack

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Levine scolds Foggy for calling him Jeff instead of Mr. Levine. He dumps the McCoy files on Foggy and Matt for the weekend.
stages.whoA: A young associate under him
stages.whoB: His boss at Landman and Zack

dropped.why: Never named on screen: in S3E4 Karen calls her only by role at the FDIC and her wife says 'Honey'; the name Tanya Mills is in the credits only (the wiki says so too).
Never named on screen: in S1E3 he has a few lines escorting Nicky Torres, but no one says his name; Forrest Tam is credits only (wiki cites the credits).
Never named on screen: the robbers' leader is called only by the joke alias 'Jesse James' / 'Mr. James' in S1E5, and 'Devlin' is in the credits only (wiki cites the credits).

Never named on screen: the transcripts of S2E3, S2E7 and S2E8 only have 'Your Honor(s)', and the bench in the wiki's screenshots has no nameplates; 'Chief Justice Waters' appears only as a subtitle speaker label and in the credits.
Never named on screen: no one says 'Grimes' in S2E3, S2E7 or S2E8 (only 'Your Honors'), and the bench in the wiki's screenshots has no nameplates; the name is credits only.

changes.why: From S3E9 Wellers is one of the agents Fisk has coerced into serving him (Hattley's meeting; he guards Fisk for him and reports to him in S3E11); forced service counts, and the app files Hattley, coerced the same way, under Fisk's Empire.

changes.where: tie Vic Jusufi|Matt Murdock, Daredevil S3, text
changes.was: Matt, jailed at Rikers under another name, wants an introduction to Vic, who has his men pull Matt out of the riot. Vic tells him Fisk paid Jasper Evans to stab him and helps Matt escape to find Evans, warning him to keep his word.
changes.now: Matt, inside Rikers on Foggy's ID, wants an introduction to Vic, who has his men pull Matt out of the riot. Vic tells him Fisk paid Jasper Evans to stab him and helps Matt escape to find Evans, warning him to keep his word.
changes.why: Matt is not jailed: he gets into Rikers as a visitor using Foggy's bar ID to see Michael Kemp, and is caught in the riot there.

changes.where: tie Winn|Ray Nadeem, Daredevil S3, text
changes.was: Nadeem calls Winn to Hattley's house and, on the record, says Fisk has corrupted Poindexter and the bureau. Winn places him on leave and moves to call him an ambulance before Hattley kills Winn with Nadeem's gun.
changes.now: Nadeem calls Winn to Hattley's house and, on the record, says Fisk has corrupted Poindexter and the bureau. Hattley places Nadeem on leave, and Winn moves to call him an ambulance before Hattley kills Winn with Nadeem's gun.
changes.why: It is Hattley, Nadeem's SAC, who places him on administrative leave; Winn then says they will call him an ambulance.

changes.where: tie Winn|Wilson Fisk, Daredevil S3, ep
changes.why: The stage's last event is Winn's death ("costs Winn his life"), which happens in S3E9 (Revelations), not S3E4.

changes.where: tie Berto|Matt Murdock, Daredevil: Born Again S2, ep
changes.why: The stage ends with Berto recording his testimony, which is shown in S2E6 (Requiem); the breakout is S2E3.
